title: Kreile WerkstattCockpit – einfache Lieferstrecke bis zum verkaufbaren Grundapp-Livegang

roles.owner: approves visual changes, main merge, production effects and new durable product/structure decisions
roles.pl: prepares exactly the active package, owns the focused spec and proves assertions-red before writer start
roles.writer: exactly one writer exists for BUILD packages only, changes only editablePaths and cannot edit the focused spec; GATE packages have no writer
roles.reviewer: independent from PL and writer; verifies exact candidate SHA
roles.coordinator: tracks sequence, process liveness, evidence and drift; writes no product code

operatingRules.ownerVisualNotice: Before every owner-view package merge request, provide preview URL, exact visible delta and three viewport screenshots.
operatingRules.doneDefinition: BUILD candidate or GATE base SHA exists, exact-SHA review PASS, package checks PASS, owner visual PASS when required, and every main merge has separate owner authority
operatingRules.blockedEnvironment: does not consume the correction round; PL fixes the environment without a new package; a repeated identical environment block escalates once to the owner
operatingRules.noPartialClaim: internal UI stages are not called delivered or live-capable until the package acceptance says the coherent route is complete

deferredAfterLive: M01 expanded finance, e-invoice and bank reconciliation
broad offline mode beyond the core safe failure contract

packages.title: Login beschleunigen und Eintrittsvertrag sichern
packages.userValue: PIN- und E-Mail-Login erreichen die unveraenderte Zielroute messbar schneller; /start bleibt Login und / bleibt Rollen-Home.
packages.externalPrerequisite: six authorized non-production test identities are bound before measurement
acceptance: cold and warm login plus first route measured n>=5 for all six roles
warm p50<=1500ms and p95<=2500ms; cold p50<=3000ms and p95<=5000ms
only the measured largest contributor is corrected; if it is outside editablePaths the PL enters BLOCKED_PRODUCT_DECISION before writer start
/start remains unauthenticated login and authenticated success reaches /
no 4xx/5xx, console error or role mismatch
